t: DRY vs WET: Ditching DRY for Explicit, Customizable Pipelines
s: This article advocates for a 'WET' (write everything twice) approach over 'DRY' (don't repeat yourself) in building flexible, explicit, and customizable development pipelines, drawing inspiration from Jupyter Notebooks and leveraging HTMX for web interactions.
sub: Jupyter Notebook-style framework for linear, top-down workflows
Contrasting explicit WET pipelines with unconstrained workflows
Leveraging HTMX for dynamic HTML chunking in pipelines
Prioritizing explicit code and customization over OOP inheritance for flexibility
